hecs_csp.label: Commonwealth supported place (HECS-HELP)
hecs_csp.payment_rule: No payment is due at enrolment. You can defer the fee with a HECS-HELP loan and repay it later through the tax system, or pay upfront by the payment due date.
hecs_csp.withdrawal_rule: Withdraw before the census date and you are not charged for the course and take on no loan debt for it.

domestic_full_fee.label: Domestic full-fee place
domestic_full_fee.payment_rule: The full fee is due by the payment due date for the term. There is no loan option in this demo data.
domestic_full_fee.withdrawal_rule: Withdraw before the census date for a full refund of the fee for that course.

international.label: International student place
international.payment_rule: The full fee is due by the payment due date for the term and must be paid upfront. No loan is available.
international.withdrawal_rule: Withdraw before the census date for a refund of the fee for that course. Changes to your study load may affect visa conditions: ask the international student office.
